text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Groove, you remembered something from 
that long ago...!? 
And the SPs gave their permission too?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, she persuaded them in an instant. 
If she says so, you can trust her."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"(『If Bubble says so...』 
They said the same thing before, but...?)"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Wah... It looks just like the magazine. 
What gorgeous architecture. 
To think we could actually come here..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Sensei! Long time no see. Sorry for 
reaching out so suddenly today. 
Thank you so much!"

text_block_list.name: Koto Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"My, my, Bubble, look how fine you've 
grown! It's really no trouble at all. 
Though I'm so sorry, none of the 
instructors are available right now..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all, don't worry about it. 
...Alright everyone, let's go get 
changed!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"So, with that said! 
Since they've lent us the room and the 
koto..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'll be your teacher—!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Bubble-chan, you can play!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I used to take lessons back when Sensei 
was still based in Tokyo. 
...See? I can at least teach beginners."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Wah... what a lovely tone... 
You're so good at this."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I knew you were capable, but I didn't 
expect this. 
Heh... well then, lead the way, Sensei."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Right, it actually takes a bit of force, 
so put some weight into your fingers... 
Keep the picks at roughly a 45-degree 
angle..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Like this, maybe... whoops...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Yup, just like that♪ Having played the 
harp must give you good intuition. 
You can be... even more free with it."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone and everything is fine, so don't 
worry. 
Just enjoy it, okay? Let those notes ring 
out nice and easy... alright?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah. 
Oh... how beautiful. It truly is so 
beautiful..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Mm, keep going. I'll harmonize with you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"('Free', huh... Ah... is it really 
alright, just for right now? 
Yes... everyone guided me here just for 
this...)"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"(What a beautiful place... What a 
wonderful time this has been. 
To be given so many precious memories—)"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew...!  
That was... truly amazing♪"

text_block_list.name: SP Captain
text_block_list.text:
"Your Highness...! That was 
magnificent...!! 
This study abroad has gained yet another 
meaningful chapter."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, did I move you to tears? 
Looks like this has become an 
unforgettable, once-in-a-lifetime 
experience."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You wouldn't have experienced this just 
sitting still, right? 
We're on a trip, after all. Let's keep 
gathering enriching experiences."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"You're right... Fufu. Now I completely 
understand what you meant. 
Truly, there was nothing at all to worry 
about."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-san! Thank you so much! 
That was so, so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure's mine. Thanks for going 
along with my sudden idea. 
To be honest, I really wanted to come here 
too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Always so sophisticated... 
It feels like there's nothing Bubble-san 
can't do.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I understand completely now. 
Just like Groove-san said, we should just 
let ourselves be spoiled this time.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Everyone is just so reliable, after all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—Bubble-chan, you really stole the show 
this time~ 
Those girls looked like they were having 
the time of their lives... ♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, they've been bouncing off the walls 
ever since we arrived at the inn. 
Allow me to thank you as well, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I really didn't do much. Just lent a 
little hand. 
You two are the ones who have been looking 
out for them all along, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph, as if it was nothing to you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You've always been like this. 
Leave you be, and you'll manage to work 
things out entirely on your own.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ooh...? What were you two like back in the 
day? 
Come on, tell me! It's not like I'll get 
another chance to hear about it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing interesting to tell. 
In fact...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Don't want to remember it anymore? 
How naive we were back then?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I did not say that. 
However, it is hardly an amusing tale.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Come on, what's the harm once in a while? 
To me, all of those memories are precious.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Air Groove, the heavy favorite! A 
magnificent victory! 
We can hardly wait for her next race!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Of course! That's our Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Bubble...! Were you waiting for me? 
I watched Race 3. Congratulations on your 
first win.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Same to you, Air Groove! That was amazing. 
Going straight for a GⅠ next, I take it? 
We've got to celebrate for the both of us 
today!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaah! It's Bubble-senpai and the Vice 
President! 
Your races the other day were amazing! 
We'll be cheering for you next time too~~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, everyone! 
I promise you: I'm definitely going to win 
the next one too!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Keep your expectations high. 
On the name of the 'Empress', I will show 
you a run worthy of setting an example for 
the younger generation.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
So wonderful~♡ They're truly the top 
two...! 
This year's Classic and Tiara belong to 
those two for sure!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—You hear that? 
The trainer said it too. That we're the 
top two of this generation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, but there is no need for two at the 
top. 
For I am the one who will reach the 
pinnacle and become the ideal for all 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Big words! That's the spirit! 
Alright, time to train some more today—!
